exam.title: Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 administration plus networking, telecommunications, SIP/PSTN, audiovisual and meeting-room fundamentals; hands-on experience with Teams Phone, Direct Routing, emergency calling, meetings/events, Teams Rooms and devices, PowerShell, Call Analytics and CQD is strongly recommended.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Plan and design collaboration communications systems
Configure and manage Teams meetings, webinars, and town halls
Configure and manage Teams Rooms and devices

review.notes: Every April 28, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a meeting/event, identity, entitlement, number, policy, PSTN/carrier/SBC, network/media, device/room, evidence, failure, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover meeting types/policies/templates/Premium/Copilot, Audio Conferencing, webinars/town halls/eCDN, Calling Plans/Operator Connect/Teams Phone Mobile/Direct Routing/Shared Calling/SMS, number lifecycle, SBC/SBA/LBR/LMO/compliance recording/contact centers/Queues app, network/QoS/CQD, voice-user policies, auto attendants/queues, emergency calling, Direct Routing implementation/troubleshooting, Rooms resource accounts/CA/enrollment, Windows/Android/SIP devices, BYOD/bookable desks and device operations. All 19 URLs are cataloged: 18 reachable and the O'Reilly page automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records 14 hours 43 minutes of Learn paths, five-day course, free Practice Assessment and April 2026 freshness gaps in older commercial resources.

findings.title: SMS registration and segment accounting are separate from voice
findings.evidence: Calling Plan support, approved registration and segment pool matter.
findings.recommendation: Add segment-based cost worksheet without prices or guaranteed delivery.
findings.resolution: Add segment-based cost worksheet without prices or guaranteed delivery.

findings.title: Shared users and the resource account need different routes
findings.evidence: Ordinary user policy has no usages; DR resource account has valid usages.
findings.recommendation: Add global inheritance, extensions and callback distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add global inheritance, extensions and callback distinctions.

findings.title: Usage order can override a specific route expectation
findings.evidence: PSTN usage order precedes matching route selection; gateway list is randomized.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic pattern/order case.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic pattern/order case.

findings.title: Offline calling has identity and emergency constraints
findings.evidence: Prior contact/tokens/CAE, clients and emergency handling have documented limits.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit continuity prerequisites and follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add explicit continuity prerequisites and follow-up.

findings.title: Signaling and media address support differ
findings.evidence: ICE Lite candidate scope remains IPv4 in current protocol article.
findings.recommendation: Keep signaling support separate from media-bypass claims.
findings.resolution: Keep signaling support separate from media-bypass claims.

findings.title: MBR and site policy do not reserve a circuit
findings.evidence: Average media limit and non-voice lookup prerequisite differ from capacity.
findings.recommendation: Add site/client scope and measured eCDN example.
findings.resolution: Add site/client scope and measured eCDN example.

findings.title: Assigned address does not prove client location
findings.evidence: LIS network ID and match precedence differ from topology/report labels.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic subnet/WAP case and client evidence.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic subnet/WAP case and client evidence.

findings.title: Blind transfer acceptance precedes target result
findings.evidence: June behavior terminates original leg after SBC acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic SIP timeline and consultative distinction.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic SIP timeline and consultative distinction.

findings.title: Conference mode and LBR have compatibility limits
findings.evidence: Recommended mode does not support the specified LBR gateway route.
findings.recommendation: Add callback budget and legacy-mode follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add callback budget and legacy-mode follow-up.

findings.title: Voice application funding differs from user minutes
findings.evidence: Outbound resource-account scenarios require route-specific entitlements.
findings.recommendation: Add current funding and delegated Queues app boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add current funding and delegated Queues app boundaries.

findings.title: Device type changes licensing
findings.evidence: Basic cap and panel/multiple-system exclusions matter.
findings.recommendation: Add minimum Pro arithmetic and entitlement qualification.
findings.resolution: Add minimum Pro arithmetic and entitlement qualification.

findings.title: Interop requires direction and provider scope
findings.evidence: Current Windows/Android SIP dialing requires Pro, provider plan and policy.
findings.recommendation: Update direction matrix and qualify older blog wording.
findings.resolution: Update direction matrix and qualify older blog wording.

findings.title: Missing join button can be calendar processing
findings.evidence: External invite bodies and URLs drive third-party meeting recognition.
findings.recommendation: Add mailbox/link checks and feature parity tests.
findings.resolution: Add mailbox/link checks and feature parity tests.

findings.title: Automatic inventory is not completed management migration
findings.evidence: Explicit profile imports, access, agent readiness and mandatory updates still apply.
findings.recommendation: Add current migration workflow and deadline follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add current migration workflow and deadline follow-up.

findings.title: Enrollment and compliance need Teams-specific preparation
findings.evidence: One enrollment profile, account-based flow and valid token/entitlement required.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped profile/compliance prerequisites.
findings.resolution: Add scoped profile/compliance prerequisites.

findings.title: XML processing is not atomic enforcement
findings.evidence: Partial application, ignored elements and consumption differ from effective state.
findings.recommendation: Add validation/recovery reasoning and preferred new settings surface.
findings.resolution: Add validation/recovery reasoning and preferred new settings surface.

findings.title: Calendar fix has an OEM exception
findings.evidence: Current Android EWS correction excludes Cisco pending another release.
findings.recommendation: Add model/build prerequisite before Exchange change and dated recheck.
findings.resolution: Add model/build prerequisite before Exchange change and dated recheck.

findings.title: SIP calling does not imply native endpoint parity
findings.evidence: Presence-based routing and stale-device behavior have distinct limits.
findings.recommendation: Add feature and reprovisioning checks.
findings.resolution: Add feature and reprovisioning checks.

findings.title: Event count does not equal distinct association evidence
findings.evidence: Auto-association needs distinct users and supported peripheral identity.
findings.recommendation: Add six-event/three-user worked example.
findings.resolution: Add six-event/three-user worked example.

findings.title: Copilot policy values distinguish default from enforcement
findings.evidence: Default Off remains organizer editable.
findings.recommendation: Add precise policy/transcript/retention checks.
findings.resolution: Add precise policy/transcript/retention checks.

findings.title: Current unified Events changes the creation experience
findings.evidence: Audience optimization controls policy behavior while legacy creation is retired.
findings.recommendation: Preserve exam terms and add current event/grace guidance.
findings.resolution: Preserve exam terms and add current event/grace guidance.

blog_intake.notes: Public synopsis/chapters read; AI-assisted/team-reviewed disclosure retained. Video not watched. Current Microsoft docs validate scoped comparison; vendor outcomes not adopted.

blog_intake.author: KerryPerezHeffernan
blog_intake.notes: Main article read in same session, fresh retrieval. Windows room identity/Android management task bounded by current docs and deployed-model checks.

offline_checks: Fourteen synthetic segment/routing/capacity/location/timeline/license/association/catalog checks. No tenant, call, configuration or network executable run.

limitations: No live tenant, SMS, PSTN, emergency, room, device, VDI, portal migration, interop, network diagnostic or external lab execution.
One OReilly page blocked; historical runtime qualified. Paid lessons/questions, interactive practice, videos and complete current commercial coverage unreviewed.
Targeted current Rooms/Agent release entries read, not the complete historical archive or every OEM firmware row. Actual cloud/OEM rollout remains a deployment prerequisite.

Empowering.Cloud synopsis discloses AI-assisted/team-reviewed summaries and vendor participation; video and benefit claims not independently validated. Current technical boundaries rely on Microsoft sources.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
